subject: Discovery: SLOs, metrics dashboard, tracing hooks & golden prompt sets
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya.shah@lexahealth.ai>, Craig Liu <craig.liu@lexahealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — SLOs / dashboards / tracing hooks / golden prompts

Hi Maya & Craig,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid overview of LexaHealth's evaluation priorities. Below is a short recap + proposed next steps so we're aligned heading into the POC. Please flag anything I missed.

Quick recap of pain points you called out:
- Observability gaps: No single dashboard for end-to-end model performance (latency, token-level errors, drift) — visibility currently spread across CloudWatch + internal logs.
- Regression risk during model updates: no golden prompt set or automated regression alerts to detect quality drops.
- Tracing / request context: inability to join user-level traces to model token streams (hard to root-cause hallucinations to prompt or model variant).
- Success criteria are business-shaped: <10% negative-quality regression on triaged prompts; 99th-percentile latency <= 400ms for user flows under baseline traffic.

Current stack you shared:
- Frontend → internal API gateway → inference requests to existing hosted endpoints (internal vendor + one open-source instance)
- Metrics: CloudWatch metrics for infra + Datadog for app-level traces; no unified model metrics dashboard yet

What you told us you need from Redwood during the eval:
1) A lightweight observability dashboard demo showing token-level metrics, per-route latency heatmaps, and prompt-level pass/fail counts (example KPIs attached as "redwood-observability-checklist.xlsx").
2) Tracing hooks we can drop into the API layer so every request includes user-session id + prompt id; ability to join those to model-level logs.
3) A starter set of golden prompts + evaluation harness to run regression alerts against new model rollouts (we'll start with 150 prompts; Redwood to provide golden_prompts_v1.txt).
4) Regression alerting and a playbook for canary rollouts & automatic fallback to a stable model variant.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
- Redwood: deliver a sandbox dashboard prototype + tracing hook snippet by Tue, 16 Mar (Karthik to lead).
- LexaHealth: share a sample of 150 triaged prompts and a representative traffic replay (anonymized) by Fri, 12 Mar.
- Joint: 45-minute POC kickoff the week of 22 Mar to wire up tracing + dashboard and validate two success cases (latency SL and quality regression detection).

I've attached a short checklist and the initial golden prompts file for formatting. If those file formats look off, tell me and we can adapt.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the kickoff once we get the sample prompt set.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-observability-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: golden_prompts_v1.txt (text)

From: Maya Shah <maya.shah@lexahealth.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Craig Liu <craig.liu@lexahealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — SLOs / dashboards / tracing hooks / golden prompts

Laura — thanks for the clear summary. Quick clarifications:
- We'll aim to deliver the 150 prompts by EOB Fri (privacy team needs to scrub PHI first). Expect a replay file (synthetic) a day later.
- For success criteria, one additional ask: we want a per-customer error rate in the dashboard so product can prioritize support outreach (not just global metrics).

Agree on the proposed timeline. Can Karthik's team include a short example of joining request traces to model token logs (a GIF or short recording is fine) so our infra folks can evaluate integration effort up front?

—Maya
Maya Shah
Head of Product, LexaHealth
maya.shah@lexahealth.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya.shah@lexahealth.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Craig Liu <craig.liu@lexahealth.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — SLOs / dashboards / tracing hooks / golden prompts

Maya, Laura — noted. A few technical notes from our side:  
- Tracing hooks: we can provide a 3-line middleware snippet (Node/Python) that attaches a session_id + prompt_id to every request and emits the same identifiers with model token logs. That will let you join Datadog traces to token-level events.
- Dashboard: we'll surface per-customer and per-route slices; per-customer view will require a customer_id field in the request header (you indicated that exists for 80% of traffic). For the remaining 20% we'll show an "unknown" bucket.
- Golden prompts: formatting guidance included in golden_prompts_v1.txt. We'll run regression checks on new model versions and surface any prompt-level deltas exceeding configurable thresholds (default 10% delta on pass-rate).

Open questions for LexaHealth:
1) Do you have a preferred alerting channel (PagerDuty, Slack, email)?
2) Are you amenable to a canary window of 2 hours for initial rollouts?

I can prepare the tracing demo GIF and prototype dashboard export by Mon, 15 Mar.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya.shah@lexahealth.ai>, Craig Liu <craig.liu@lexahealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — SLOs / dashboards / tracing hooks / golden prompts

Thanks, all — quick confirmation and next administrative steps: 
- LexaHealth: please upload the scrubbed prompt set to the Drive link below and share access to the replay artifact (we'll only use it for the POC).
- LexaHealth: confirm alerting channel preference (Slack suggested) and whether customer_id is available in request headers for >=80% of traffic.
- Redwood: Karthik to share tracing GIF + dashboard prototype by Mon, 15 Mar; Aditya will prepare a short runbook for canary rollback behavior.
- I'll send a calendar invite for the POC kickoff for Thu, 24 Mar at 10am PT once we have the prompt set.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/lexahealth-discovery-notes
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/LEX-2027-03

If anything above needs changing, let me know today so we can proceed on schedule. Looking forward to getting this wired up.

Best,

Laura Bennett
